old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-aqyw","title":"Rust tunnel_auth evicts replay/revocation floors under capacity pressure; Python fail-closes with CAPACITY (P-R divergence)","description":"Found by 3x codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-0rep (two reviewers converged, P1/P2 family). rust/lichen-gateway/src/tunnel_auth.rs floors are bounded at N with silent LRU eviction: accept_post floor_index fallback :339-348 evicts min-used floor, revoke() :247-256 does the same on unknown-key revoke with full floors (returns Ok). A revoked floor's used is never refreshed after revoke() (its entry was deleted; authorize_decapsulation refresh :408-414 only touches floors matching an ACCEPTED claim), so a revoked floor is always the first eviction candidate. If evicted, replaying the captured revoked POST (claim still unexpired) finds no floor and no entry -\u003e accept_post re-accepts it and re-arms the data plane. Python mirror python/src/lichen/gateway/tunnel_auth.py never evicts floors: floors capped at _max_history (4x max_entries, :388), receive_post denies CAPACITY when full (:484-485), revoke() raises 'authorization replay history is full' and mutates nothing (:503-505); _revoked persists until genuine re-arm (:491) or root change (:435). Same inputs: Rust accepts, Python denies. Exploitability is low (forcing eviction of the target key needs N distinct newly-accepted keys, which requires fresh root-signed grants, not replays) but it is a semantic weakening plus a hard cross-impl divergence. Fix: mirror Python - give floors their own bounded history that fail-closes with a Capacity/TunnelAuthError variant when full (accept_post and revoke), never silently evict; align capacity constant with Python's 4x; add unit tests for accept-on-full and revoke-on-full; add shared vector post_cases if the corpus schema can express capacity denials.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-08-30T20:55:26.779548777Z","created_by":"opencode-worker-1","updated_at":"2026-08-30T20:55:26.779548777Z","dependencies":[{"issue_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-aqyw","depends_on_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-0rep","type":"discovered-from","created_at":"2026-08-30T20:55:26.926371099Z","created_by":"opencode-worker-1","metadata":"{}"}]}
